call_points.text: Operating margin 16.5% in Q2, up 0.5% QoQ; management wants the 17-17.5% band but gives no timeline.
Q2 TCV was $2.6 billion with nine large deals; two confirmed deals slipped on unsigned paperwork into Q3.

Operating cash flow was 166% of net income; gross cash at 30 September was $4.6 billion.
AI-Native Unit has over 2,000 engineers including forward deployed engineers; AI services span five growth themes.
Inorganic strategy continues; Mindsprint added one month of revenue, Alpha Net was a tuck-in not called out as material.

operating_notes.text: Wipro and Kongsberg Digital will jointly market AI-powered digital twins combining Wipro's Industrial-AssetsAI and UpstreamAI with Kongsberg's Industrial Work Surface; no value or timeline disclosed.
Mindsprint, acquired from Olam Group and completed on 15 May 2026, employs over 3,200 professionals and brings IP including Farmsprint®, Procuresprint®, SprintAP™, Salessprint™ and Tradesprint®.
Buyback of up to 60,00,00,000 shares at ₹250 each, up to ₹15,000 Cr, equals 24.99% of standalone and 19.99% of consolidated paid-up capital plus free reserves as at March 31, 2026.
Expanded partnership with ServiceNow to integrate Wipro Intelligence for agentic AI workflows across core enterprise functions.
Wipro IT Services, LLC agreed to acquire an additional 20% stake in Aggne Global Inc. for USD 28.5 million, increasing its shareholding to 80%.
B S R & Co. LLP (FRN 101248W/W-100022) is proposed as Wipro's statutory auditor for five years from the 81st AGM to the 86th AGM, subject to shareholder approval at the 81st AGM in 2027.
Gross cash including investments was $4.3 billion, with operating cash flow at 98% of net income in Q1FY27.
Accounting yield on average investments held in India was stable at 7.2% in Q1FY27.
Order booking of $3.4 billion included 13 large deals worth $1.6 billion; some deal decisions slipped into Q2.
Q2FY27 IT Services revenue was ₹24,667 Cr, with Europe at ₹6,755 Cr and APMEA at ₹3,095 Cr.
Amortisation and impairment on intangibles in IT Services was ₹284 Cr in Q2FY27, up from ₹167 Cr a year ago.
Share-based compensation expense in IT Services was ₹134.5 Cr in Q2FY27.
Wipro IT Services, LLC agreed to acquire 20% in FLARRE.AI, Inc. for USD 2,000.
Q2FY27 TCV was $2.6 billion with nine large deals; two confirmed deals slipped on unsigned paperwork into Q3.
AI-Native Unit has over 2,000 engineers including forward deployed engineers; AI services span five themes: AI data centers, AI foundry services, physical AI, AI devices and design-to-manufacturing.
Gross cash at 30 September 2026 was $4.6 billion; Q2 operating cash flow was 166% of net income.
Completed the acquisition of a 20% stake in FLARRE.AI, Inc. via Wipro IT Services, LLC on 28 October 2026.

timeline.summary: On 24 April 2026, Wipro announced a strategic partnership with Kongsberg Digital to jointly deploy AI-powered digital twin solutions for the Energy & Utilities sector, with no value disclosed.
Wipro completed the 100% acquisition of Mindsprint Pte. Ltd. and its subsidiaries on May 15, 2026.
On 15 May 2026, Wipro completed its acquisition of Olam Group's IT and digital services business Mindsprint, which becomes a wholly owned subsidiary with over 3,200 employees.
Shareholders approved Ms. Tulsi Naidu’s re-appointment as Independent Director for 5 years from July 1, 2026, via remote e-voting on May 21, 2026.
Wipro published the public announcement for its ₹15,000 Cr share buyback at ₹250 per share with record date on June 5, 2026.
On 25 May 2026, Wipro issued the public announcement for its ₹15,000 Cr buyback of up to 60 Cr shares at ₹250 each, with a record date of 5 June 2026.
On 28 May 2026, Wipro announced an expanded partnership with ServiceNow to embed agentic AI workflows across core enterprise functions.
On June 1, 2026, Wipro announced that its step-down subsidiary Wipro IT Services, LLC will acquire an additional 20% stake in Aggne Global Inc. for USD 28.5 million, taking its total holding to 80%.

On 2 June 2026, Wipro's board approved proposing B S R & Co. LLP as statutory auditor for five years from the 81st AGM, replacing Deloitte Haskins & Sells LLP whose term ends there, subject to shareholder approval; KPMG was approved as the Form 20-F auditor for FY2028.
03 June 2026: Wipro announced the online availability of its FY26 Annual Report on Form 20-F for ADS holders.
Wipro guided Q2FY27 IT services revenue to -1.5% to +0.5% QoQ in constant currency after Q1 margin fell 120 bps YoY to 16%.
On 13 October 2026, Wipro clarified that the U.S. Department of Labor's suspension of new PERM applications will not have a material business impact due to its high local hiring in the U.S.
2026-10-15: Wipro reported Q2FY27 consolidated revenue of ₹24,818 Cr and PBT of ₹4,205 Cr
On 15 October 2026, Wipro announced through its subsidiary the acquisition of a 20% stake in FLARRE.AI, Inc. for USD 2,000.
2026-10-16: Wipro's Q2FY27 call guided Q3 IT services revenue to -1.5% to +0.5% QoQ in constant currency, with Q2 operating margin at 16.5% and TCV of $2.6 billion.
Completed the acquisition of a 20% stake in FLARRE.AI, Inc. via step-down subsidiary Wipro IT Services, LLC on October 28, 2026.
